paragraphs: R' Hanina the Elder. Mentioned in Tanchuma, Shofetim 8, where he posed a difficulty to R' Hanina.[^1][^2]

notes.text: שופטים-ח gives Shofetim 8; no Tanchuma edition is specified or independently checked.
The Elder is the heading’s explicit qualifier. The notice presents him posing a difficulty to another named Hanina without equating the two people. Both abbreviated titles remain R'.
